note: S11.5 (R-lift) base case: edges_rec on a FLAT bridge ($fx.arr = {segments, bindings:{}, off_top:[]}) is BYTE-IDENTICAL to edges_md($fx.arr.segments; T). With empty bindings no cell has a non-empty .nested.segments, so the per-cell child-edges fold contributes nothing and edges_rec reduces to edges_md's per-display segment-as-edge + _bag_corners fold, with the same sort_by([display_id,axis,coord,lo]) / ([display_id,x,y]). Scene reuses edges_md_intra_bag_corner: a v@500 and h@500 crossing WITHIN display 1 → two edges + a corner at {500,500}; display 2 (no segment) contributes nothing. The harness emits {eq:bool}.
